emprendedor.label: Entrepreneur
emprendedor.title: ENTREPRENEUR
emprendedor.tagline: Sales, focus and cash. Every day, one action that moves the business.
emprendedor.description: Finances and contract up front. Projects with a final boss and a date. The coach asks you for numbers: contacts, closed deals, revenue.
emprendedor.campaignsHint: A project is a campaign: tasks, a final boss and a date. Clear it and there's loot.
emprendedor.goalExample: Bill €5,000 a month with my business

trabajador.label: Professional
trabajador.title: PROFESSIONAL
trabajador.tagline: Grow in your job without neglecting your body. Focus during the workday, order outside it.
trabajador.description: Report, progress and journal up front, with the gym and finances at hand. Career goals with a final milestone and a date. The coach protects your focus blocks and fits training, meals and rest around your workday.
trabajador.campaignsHint: A career goal is a campaign: steps as tasks, a final milestone and a date. Reach it and there's loot.

deportista.label: Athlete
deportista.title: ATHLETE
deportista.tagline: Training, food and rest. Progress is measured in kilos, pace and consistency.
deportista.description: Gym, cardio, nutrition and diet up front. Season blocks with a goal and a date. The coach prescribes loads from your RPE and adjusts your diet to your weight trend.
deportista.campaignsHint: A season block is a campaign: sessions, a final goal and a date. Reach it and there's loot.
deportista.goalExample: Get down to 78 kg without losing strength

estudiante.label: Student
estudiante.title: STUDENT
estudiante.tagline: Real study hours, exams as final bosses and a clear head.
estudiante.description: Journal, report and progress up front. Subjects with the exam as the final boss. The coach splits your study into blocks and makes sure you rest.
estudiante.campaignsHint: A subject is a campaign: topics as tasks, the exam as the boss and its date. Pass it and there's loot.
estudiante.goalExample: Pass all four subjects in June

general.label: General
general.title: GLADIATOR
general.tagline: Body, mind and habits. 1% better every day, in whatever you decide.
general.description: Every module in view. Campaigns for any challenge with a date. The coach asks what you want to conquer and turns it into missions.
general.campaignsHint: A campaign is a challenge with a date: tasks, a final boss and loot when you clear it.
general.goalExample: Train four days a week for a year

mision.formacion: 30 min of training in your field
